items.hook: The Matchmaker is a 2010 Israeli drama film written, directed and produced by Avi Nesher, based on the novel When Heroes Fly by award-winning author Amir Gutfreund.
items.body: It premiered as an official selection at the 2010 Toronto International Film Festival and later that year won the Silver Plaque award at the Chicago International Film Festival. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Ships of the South and North Korean navies skirmish off Daecheong Island in the Yellow Sea.
items.body: The Daecheong incident, also known as the Battle of Daecheong, was a skirmish between the South Korean and North Korean navies near the Northern Limit Line (NLL) on 10 November 2009 off Daecheong Island. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Cold therapy may be worse than doing nothing for post-exercise recovery
items.body: Many are convinced that ice baths or cold showers are an effective way to speed recovery after exercise, but a study finds that cold therapy may actually have the opposite effect

items.hook: Treaty of Osimo between Yugoslavia and Italy
items.body: The Treaty of Osimo was signed on 10 November 1975 by Italy and Yugoslavia in Osimo, Italy, to definitively divide the Free Territory of Trieste between the two states: the port city of Trieste with a narrow coastal strip to the north-west was given to Italy; a portion of the north-western part of the Istrian peninsula was given to Yugoslavia. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Raden Wijaya is crowned as the first monarch of Majapahit kingdom of Java, taking the throne name Kertarajasa Jayawardhana.
items.body: Raden Wijaya (Rāden Wijaya, also spelt Vijaya) alias Nararya Sangramawijaya (Regnal name Kertarajasa Jayawardhana) was a Javanese prince and the founder of the Majapahit Empire, which ruled Java and much of the Nusantara spanning both Asia and Oceania until the 16th century. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
